From: Emma Walsh <emma.walsh@bluepay.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and audit period confirmation

Hi Laura,

We are kicking off procurement for BluePay's planned integration with Redwood Inference and need to collect SOC 2 coverage artifacts for our security review. Can you please provide the following as soon as possible?

- The most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy is fine).
- If the report does not cover up to Feb 2027, a bridge letter or statement that covers the gap and confirms controls remained in place (dates we need covered: 2026-09-01 through 2027-02-28).
- An evidence coverage matrix that maps services/systems in-scope (e.g., storage, KV encryption, log retention, access controls, incident response) to the report sections or artifact names so our auditors can triage.
- Point of contact for security and legal/procurement for any follow-ups or NDA/contract redlines.

We have a procurement review kickoff on Monday; an ETA by end of day Friday would be ideal. For now, please send any attachments or a secure link.

Attaching our standard RFI for context.

Thanks,
Emma Walsh
Sr. Security Analyst
BluePay

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the RFI. Short answer: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter covering the period you specified; we'll also supply a coverage matrix that maps artifacts to the report sections.

To speed things up, I'm including: 1) a bridge-letter template you can expect (attached), 2) our evidence-coverage matrix template (attached), and 3) a short reply template you can forward internally if you need to escalate with procurement/legal.

Attachments in this email: SOC2_2026_TypeII_Report.pdf (redacted), SOC2_Bridge_Letter_Template.docx, evidence_coverage_matrix_template.xlsx

Quick notes / constraints:
- The redacted SOC 2 we are attaching covers the audit period 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31. It does not include controls testing after Aug 31, 2026; the bridge letter will attest continuity through Feb 28, 2027.
- We redact customer-identifying data and some vendor pricing schedules; if auditors need an unredacted copy under NDA, we can coordinate through Contract Ops.

Reply template (copy/paste if helpful):
---
Subject: Redwood SOC 2 materials and bridge letter
Hi team,
Redwood has provided a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter attesting control continuity through 2027-02-28. They also shared an evidence coverage matrix to map systems in-scope to report sections. Please see attached and advise next steps for auditor access or NDA if unredacted artifacts are required.
Best,
Emma
---

Let me know if you want me to loop in Contract Ops for an NDA/secure artifact transfer. Priyom / Neha / Vivek — tagging you for evidence matrix ownership and to confirm the bridge wording below.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
